name: strands-crm
description: RPG Fuel Platform: an agentic fuel operations platform (order intake, pricing, loads, BOLs, billing, profitability) built with CopilotKit, the AG-UI protocol, and a TypeScript Strands agent.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:agent" "npm run dev:ui" --names agent,ui --prefix-colors green,blue --kill-others
scripts.test: npm --prefix agent test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix agent install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix agent run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
